playbackToolbar.gridMarker: Set the initial grid position from the current playback point.
playbackToolbar.loopIn: Store the current position as the loop start point.
playbackToolbar.loopOut: Store the current position as the loop end point.
playbackToolbar.loopActive: Enable or disable looping for the selected range.
playbackToolbar.loopSnap: Snap loop points and loop-size actions to the active timing grid.
playbackToolbar.loopSize: Resize the selected loop to this musical length using the current BPM grid.
playbackToolbar.trackBpm: Set the track BPM used by GRID 1 and loop-size tools.

cosmicToggle.x: Enable or disable Cosmic LFO modulation on the X axis.
cosmicToggle.y: Enable or disable Cosmic LFO modulation on the Y axis.
cosmicToggle.z: Enable or disable Cosmic LFO modulation on the Z axis.

sensorToggle.x: Route device sensors to control the X axis.
sensorToggle.y: Route device sensors to control the Y axis.
sensorToggle.z: Route device sensors to control the Z axis.

multiplierHalf.x: Halve the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the X axis.
multiplierHalf.y: Halve the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the Y axis.
multiplierHalf.z: Halve the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the Z axis.

multiplierDouble.x: Double the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the X axis.
multiplierDouble.y: Double the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the Y axis.
multiplierDouble.z: Double the Cosmic LFO frequency driving the Z axis.

knobs.syncBpm: Shared BPM reference used by tempo sync controls.

axis.x: Fine-tune the modulation depth for the X axis.
axis.y: Fine-tune the modulation depth for the Y axis.
axis.z: Fine-tune the modulation depth for the Z axis.

cosmicAmplitude.x: Set how deep the Cosmic LFO pushes the X axis.
cosmicAmplitude.y: Set how deep the Cosmic LFO pushes the Y axis.
cosmicAmplitude.z: Set how deep the Cosmic LFO pushes the Z axis.

manualFrequency.x: Dial in a manual Cosmic LFO frequency for the X axis.
manualFrequency.y: Dial in a manual Cosmic LFO frequency for the Y axis.
manualFrequency.z: Dial in a manual Cosmic LFO frequency for the Z axis.
